summary: trivialLift is also the class sum of the translated kernel forms, which the operator maps back.

steps.claim: twistedCentralOp z is additive, so it commutes with the class sum that defines trivialLift.

trivialLift is also the class sum of u ↦ kernelForm(u·z⁻¹) (trivialLift_eq_stdClassSum_translate with z⁻¹), and twistedCentralOp z maps kernelForm(u·z⁻¹) to kernelForm(u) (twistedCentralOp_kernelForm for z⁻¹); so the image of trivialLift is the class sum of the kernelForm(u), which is trivialLift.
